title: Write-ahead log in one minute
summary: Durability from a sequential log, with replay after a crash.

messages.content: You are an assistant for a CLI tool. Answer concisely and informatively. Prefer markdown if possible.
What does a write-ahead log give a database?
Durability without flushing data pages on every commit: append and fsync the log record first, then replay it after a crash. It also turns random page writes into sequential log writes.
